title: Learn English through the Adult Migrant English Program
summary: Learn or improve your English skills and learn about Australian life through the free Adult Migrant English Program.
intro:
The Adult Migrant English Program (AMEP) helps eligible newcomers to Australia to learn or improve their English.

The program is free, and you study:

• English speaking• listening• reading• writing skills.

You also learn about Australian society, culture, customs, and working within Australia.

Day or evening classes are available at TAFE NSW campuses on weekdays and Saturdays.

TAFE also offers some online classes, and you can study by distance learning or with a volunteer tutor.
